surface: Official @rive-app/react-canvas 4.32.0 hook and Rive canvas-wrapper surface over the unchanged @rive-app/canvas@2.40.0 runtime, with Octane createElement host output and manual hook-slot forwarding.
divergences: JSX in useRive / Rive is rewritten with Octane createElement. There is no forwardRef.
Hooks are authored in plain .ts and forward compiler-injected trailing slots through splitSlot / subSlot.
jsdom cannot run Rive WASM; committed tests are contract-level (export surface, pre-load useRive, canvas wrapper, null state-machine input) rather than a full runtime load.
ssr: Initial hook state is null / idle. Effects construct Rive only after a canvas is attached on the client.
